name: complement C6

function.text: C6 is the approved symbol for complement C6. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in complement activation; complement activation, GZMK pathway.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include complement component 6 deficiency (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Ovarian carcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; Strong GenCC assertion, Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific review required.
